source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology.leaves: Vigorous-shoot blades 3–9(–12) × 1.5–4(–6) cm, often lobed, underside tomentose; flowering-shoot blades 2–5 × 1–2 cm, elliptic-ovate, underside generally tomentose
morphology.twigs: Deciduous stipules 3–8 mm; leaves folded lengthwise in bud

source_scope_note: Species-level and key-level traits distinguished; modern secondary traits stay attributed to their own sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: No direct species treatment in Diggs 1999; Malus only in family narrative
Flora of North America describes leaf heteromorphy between vigorous and flowering shoots; these are independent modern traits
Native range of central/north-central US does not establish Hays County nativity
preservation: Additive research only, species JSON and photo/attribution/gallery assets unchanged
